disclaimer: Terminal-centered coordinates for orientation only; not statutory port boundaries. Radii are manually assigned — not derived from official port limits.
radius_methodology: Each site has a fixed lat/lon near the petroleum terminal (reference: OpenStreetMap / public port listings, frozen in this file). radius_km is chosen manually (3–6 km) to approximate quay + tank-farm night lighting at VIIRS ~750 m resolution — smaller ports use tighter radii; large LNG/crude complexes use wider radii. The map shows a circle; the backend averages pixels in a square bounding box ±radius_km around the center (see methodology page).
